_comment: Add/remove feeds here — no code changes needed. type: rss | google_news | reddit. trusted: true skips the keyword pre-filter (every item goes to the AI classifier). tz: timezone for feeds whose dates have no offset (RBI publishes IST without one).

google_news.name: Google News: RBI/FEMA
google_news.query: (RBI OR "Reserve Bank") (FEMA OR "foreign exchange" OR remittance OR "master direction" OR LRS)

google_news.name: Google News: LRS/TCS
google_news.query: LRS OR "Liberalised Remittance Scheme" OR "outward remittance" OR "TCS on foreign remittance"

google_news.name: Google News: Medical tourism India
google_news.query: "medical tourism" OR "medical value travel" OR "heal in India"

google_news.name: Google News: Medical visa
google_news.query: "medical visa" OR "e-medical visa" OR "medical attendant visa"

google_news.name: Google News: Medical tourism abroad
google_news.query: "medical tourism" (Thailand OR Turkey OR UAE OR Dubai OR Malaysia OR Singapore OR Bangladesh OR Nepal OR Iraq OR Oman OR Kenya OR Nigeria)

google_news.name: Google News: Remittance rules abroad
google_news.query: remittance (rules OR tax OR limit OR regulation) (UAE OR Saudi OR USA OR UK OR Singapore OR Bangladesh OR Nigeria OR Kenya)

google_news.name: Google News: Currency/capital controls
google_news.query: "capital controls" OR "currency controls" OR "foreign exchange rules" OR "forex regulations" central bank
